## `device.app.lifecycle`

**Stability:** development

This event represents an occurrence of a lifecycle transition on Android or iOS platform.

The event body fields MUST be used to describe the state of the application at the time of the event.
This event is meant to be used in conjunction with `os.name` [resource semantic convention](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/resource/os/) to identify the mobile operating system (e.g. Android, iOS).
The `android.app.state` and `ios.app.state` fields are mutually exclusive and MUST NOT be used together, each field MUST be used with its corresponding `os.name` value.

| Attribute | Type | Requirement level | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `android.app.state` | `enum` | conditionally required (if and only if `os.name` is `android`) | This attribute represents the state of the application. |
| `ios.app.state` | `enum` | conditionally required (if and only if `os.name` is `ios`) | This attribute represents the state of the application. |
